steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing. Wait 3 minutes after unplugging before measuring SMPS terminals (160 Vdc may remain). R-134a sealed-system precautions apply.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Enter Test Mode 1
steps.body: Press main PCB test button once — F-FAN runs continuously.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press main PCB test button once — F-FAN runs continuously.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: PCB test mode entered. Continue with component-specific checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After §2-17 test mode entry, proceed with OEM component tests.

steps.title: Fan stops when door opens?
steps.body: Open freezer or refrigerator door during Test 1 — F-FAN should stop; resumes when door closes (switches A/B/C/D in parallel).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open freezer or refrigerator door during Test 1 — F-FAN should stop; resumes when door closes (switches A/B/C/D in parallel).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace door switch or repair harness to main PCB.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace failed door switch (A/B/C/D) or repair parallel sense circuit.

steps.title: Door switch OK
steps.oemOutcome: Door switch input and Test Mode fan-stop behavior verified.
